segments.title: Here's how, in 3 steps
segments.say: This AI app's access? Removed. Here's how, in three steps.

segments.title: Ollie was set to close Nov 6
segments.say: Ollie, an AI inbox app, was set to close November sixth. Here's how to take back its access.

segments.title: Google account
segments.say: Google: open your linked apps page, tap the app, remove access.

segments.title: Microsoft account
segments.say: Microsoft: go to microsoft dot com slash consent, and remove its permissions.

segments.title: Removing access isn't deleting
segments.say: Removing access doesn't delete what it already has. Ask the app to delete it too.
Save this for your next app clean-up, and follow Nexora, the honest referee for AI.
segments.sub: Nexora: the honest referee for AI. Follow for one a day.
